title: Minnesota Fraud Research Warning / Who-Knew-What-When
description: Institutional-knowledge record for complaints, warnings, audit findings, anomalies, provider flags, media reports, lawsuits, referrals, or enforcement contacts. Enables visualization of warning → recipient → required action → actual action → subsequent payments → later allegation/proof without editorializing beyond the evidence. OLA found MDE received at least 30 complaints concerning Feeding Our Future or its sites between June 2018 and December 2021; some were not investigated, others were inadequately investigated, and MDE at times asked Feeding Our Future to investigate complaints about itself. That pattern is exactly what this schema is for.

warning_id.description: Durable identifier. Never use a display name as a key.

warning_type.description: e.g. complaint, audit_finding, internal_warning, media_report, lawsuit, referral, enforcement_contact, anomaly, provider_flag, legislative_inquiry.

date.description: Date the warning/complaint/finding was made or received.

sender.description: Who sent or filed the warning/complaint.

allegation.description: What was alleged or flagged, in sourced language.

evidence_supplied.description: What supporting evidence accompanied the warning, if any.

required_response.description: What duty, policy, or statute required in response, if known.

actual_response.description: What the recipient actually did, including 'no documented response'.

law_enforcement_referral.description: Whether/when the matter was referred to law enforcement. Boolean or sourced description.

payment_status_afterward.description: Whether payments continued, were withheld, or changed after the warning.

provider_status_afterward.description: Enrollment, suspension, termination, or other provider status after the warning.

later_consequence.description: Later prosecution, audit finding, or other consequence, if any.
